records.title: ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. 10-K 2021
records.text: •SaaS and license revenue increased 17% to $460.4 million in 2021 from $393.3 million in 2020.

records.title: ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. 10-K 2021
records.text: During parts of 2019 and 2020, we accounted for the contingent consideration using fair value and established a liability for the future earn-out payment based on an estimation of revenue attributable to perpetual licenses and subscription licenses over the 2020 calendar year.

records.title: ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. 10-K 2021
records.text: SaaS and license revenue represented 61%, 64% and 67% of our revenue in 2021, 2020 and 2019, respectively.

records.title: ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. 10-K 2021
records.text: While the additional import duties have resulted in an increase to our cost of hardware revenue, these import duties had a modest impact on hardware revenue margins.

records.title: ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. 10-K 2021
records.text: For 2021, cash flows from operating activities were $103.2 million, compared to $102.1 million for 2020.
